Give the '$50,000' tag slightly larger type or a pointer arrow toward its character so its meaning (who costs what) is legible at 6 inches in daylight
Fix the overlap: the '$1' badge collides with and clips the '$9,000,000' sign — separate or merge them into one tag anchored to the character
Give the '$12,000' tag clear ownership — it floats ambiguously between the middle and right characters; attach it with a pointer or position it above the correct head
Darken/soften the teal shoes on background characters and dim the window glow squares slightly so the glowing protagonist remains the sole focal point
Title sign overlaps the character's hood edge — lift it 60-80px or nudge left so the glyph margin never kisses the subject silhouette

Character's raincoat body reads as a flat trapezoid with muddy navy-on-navy interior seams — add a subtle rim highlight or fabric break so the torso doesn't merge with the night buildings
Fill the lower third dead zone (empty road below the character's feet) with a subtle ground reflection or foreground element to tighten the composition
The right-edge '$1' tag is clipped mid-frame — either fully include or push it further off-screen so it reads as intentional depth, not a crop error
Give the '$1' price badge above the character a distinct accent (warm orange to match tags) so the key payload separates from the pale moon directly behind it
Boost the big '$1' tag contrast — the navy-on-navy outline against the lit doorway edges toward mush on a small screen; add a brighter rim or darker fill

Fix the cropped price tags: '$2,000' and '12,000' are cut off at the frame edges — pull them inward and add pointer arrows toward the correct characters

Strengthen the '$1' bubble as the sole focal point — enlarge it, add a subtle pulse/glow distinct from the generic character rim light so the eye lands there first

Fill the large dead zone between the header and the characters (roughly the top 30% of frame) — either drop the header closer or enlarge characters ~15%

Upper third (~moon zone) is a large dead sky — subtle fog gradient, city glow, or drifting particles would add depth without clutter
Top ~35% of frame is an empty gradient dead zone — raise the characters or add moon/skyline interest to fill it
The dollar-bill's '$1' and the sign's '$1' compete for smallest-focal-point status; make the transactional element (bill) larger and glow it
